text:
PACE (Professional Association for Communication Enthusiasts)  is a vibrant student association established 
by the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at SV College of Engineering. True to 
its name, PACE s erves as a dynamic platform for ECE students to showcase and strengthen their technical 
expertise and communication abilities. 
The association regularly conducts a wide range of events, workshops, technical sessions, and competitions, all 
designed to nurture the professional potential of students and to equip them with the skills required to meet future 
challenges in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering.
